Commentary.Commentary: Right then. That is all we have from this game. The series stands at 2-0 in favour of Bangladesh. But as seen in this game, New Zealand are now getting back to form. The Kiwis will come all guns blazing in the next game to save the series. The third T20I will be on 5th September, at 4 pm Local (10 am GMT). Do join us for the same. Till then, take care and goodbye!

Mahmudullah, the Bangladeshi skipper, is also the PLAYER OF THE MATCH. He says that he is happy to get over the line. Adds that Mustafizur Rahman held his nerves very well. Adds that Mahedi Hasan has been bowling really well and is keeping things tight. He also credits Shakib Al Hasan and Nasum Ahmed for the way they bowled. Says that they always believed that they are a very good team in this format and are happy to be winning games consistently.

Tom Latham, the New Zealand skipper, says that it was a great game of cricket. Adds that they turned things around from the last game with the bat. Says that Rachin Ravindra was brilliant and other bowlers were also very good. States that he was looking to bat through the innings and the other batters were looking to be more aggressive.

Earlier in the day, after electing to bat first, Bangladesh got to a good total courtesy of decent knocks by Mohammad Naim, Liton Das and Mahmudullah. New Zealand did get close but it was Bangladesh who emerged victorious and have taken a 2-0 lead in this series.

The bowling of Bangladesh was once again led by the spinners. Mahedi Hasan, Nasum Ahmed and Shakib Al Hasan combined to take 5 wickets and did not give away a lot. Mustafizur Rahman was slightly expensive according to his usual standards but he held his nerves in the final over to see his team home. Mohammad Saifuddin did not have the best of games but bowled well in the penultimate over. However, the good work by the spinners covered up for the average effort by the pacers.

New Zealand though can be a lot happier with their effort with the bat. They were led by their skipper Tom Latham. He though needed support. Will Young did hang around for a bit but could not make most of the start. Had there been one cameo from one of the big hitters, things could have well been different. Latham fought till the last ball, but could not get them over the line. New Zealand though will still be pleased as they did make a good effort after being bundled out for 60 in the last game.

Phew! What a game! Tom Latham fought till the end but could not get his team over the line. Yet again a good win for Bangladesh! Yes, it did get nervy towards the end but Mustafizur Rahman kept his cool. Their bowlers have risen to the occasion once again. Yes, over 140 was always above par but defending a total in that range, irrespective of the wicket, is a tough task and they are mastering it at least at home.
Mustafizur Rahman delivers! He does it for his team! Length ball, outside off. Latham heaves it to deep mid-wicket for one. Bangladesh win by 4 runs!

TWO LEG BYES! The game is still alive! Mustafizur Rahman bowls a full one, on the pads. Latham gets hit on the pads while looking to flick. This could have been out if it wasn't a Free Hit. The ball goes to deep square leg and they get a couple of leg byes. 6 from the last ball now!

NO BALL AND FOUR! So much drama out there! Mustafizur Rahman ends up bowling a very high full toss, outside off. Latham hangs his bat out and gets some bat on it. The ball takes the inside edge and goes past the keeper to the fine leg fence. So, 8 from 2 now and the next ball is a Free Hit!
13 from 2 now! Back of a length, outside off. Cole McConchie punches it to sweeper cover for one.
14 from 3 now! Shorter ball, outside off. Cut away past point. The man in the deep runs across to his left and keeps it to two.
Just a single! Length ball, wide outside off. Latham smacks it towards long off for one.

Just short of the fielder! Length ball, on leg. Cole McConchie looks to slog but mistimes. The ball goes towards deep mid-wicket. The fielder runs in and dives but the ball falls short of him and goes past him. But he recovers well and stops it from going to the fence. Three runs taken.
Right then. 20 needed from 6 balls. Mustafizur Rahman to bowl this one.
Just a single! And Tom Latham will not be on strike! Yorker, wide outside off. Cole McConchie digs it towards point for one.
Just a single. Full ball, on the pads. Whipped to deep square leg for one. A very important ball coming up.
Dot ball! Length ball, outside off. Latham looks to reverse paddle it over short third man but misses. Mohammad Saifuddin puts in an appeal but finds no support.

NOT OUT! Plenty of drama! Length ball, on the pads. Latham whips it to deep square leg. He wants to get back on strike and sprints back. But the fielder fires a great throw to the keeper and Nurul Hasan takes the bails off. Latham is gone for all money, but the other angle shows that Nurul Hasan has dislodged the bails before gathering the ball!
Is that a run out? Yes, Tom Latham is short. Oh, hold on. The other angle shows that Nurul Hasan has dislodged the bails with his gloves before the ball was in his hands!
FOUR! That is good batting by Latham! He is playing the field well. Shorter and slower ball, on leg. Latham gets inside the line of the ball and scoops it over the keeper for a boundary.
Well bowled. A wide yorker to start the over. Latham looks to run it to third man but gets no bat on it.
Mohammad Saifuddin to bowl the penultimate over. 28 needed in 2 overs now.
Latham misses out! A full toss, on the pads. He whips it straight towards deep square leg for one. He enquires about the height of that ball but the umpire is satisfied.
Shorter ball, outside off. Cut away to deep point for one.
Length ball, on the pads. Latham sweeps it to deep square leg for one.
FOUR! Latham bisects the field! Slower ball, on off. Latham hammers it towards wide long on. The ball goes between long on and deep mid-wicket for a boundary.
Shorter ball, on off. Cole McConchie misses the pull. The ball goes to the off side and the batters cross over. Given as runs, so maybe there was some bat on it.

NOT OUT! Slower ball, on a length, outside off. Cole McConchie goes for the slog but misses. The keeper collects and puts in a mild appeal. The appeal is turned down but Mahmudullah takes the review. UltraEdge rolls in and it confirms that there is no bat on that one.
Review. Bangladesh have reviewed this for caught behind. There is no bat on that.
Length ball, down the leg side. Cole McConchie misses the pull. Wide called.
Mustafizur Rahman (2-0-12-0) is back in the attack.
FOUR! That is a glorious stroke by Latham! Tossed up, on off. Latham backs away to the leg side and lifts it over covers for a boundary. 37 needed in the last 3 overs.
Nicely placed. Darted on the pads. Latham works it to the left of long on and sprints back for the second.
Flatter ball, on off. Cole McConchie works it past mid-wicket for one.
Loopy ball, on off. Chipped down towards long on for a couple of runs.

Just over! Loopy ball, on off. Cole McConchie comes down the track to smack but gets it from the outer half. The ball goes over covers. The fielder gives it a chase but the ball goes over him. Two taken.

NOT OUT! Cole McConchie survives! Loopy ball, on off. Cole McConchie looks to go for the reverse sweep but misses. The ball hits the pads and the umpire raises the finger. The review is taken and Ball Tracker shows that the ball is missing the off pole!
Review time! Cole McConchie has reviewed the LBW decision! The ball is missing the stumps!
Singles won't bother Bangladesh now. Darted on the pads. Cole McConchie works it past square leg for one.
Flatter ball, on the pads. Latham works it past square leg for one.
Almost! Tossed up, outside off. Latham misses the sweep and the ball goes just past the off pole.
Cole McConchie walks out to bat.

OUT! TAKEN! The sweep costs Henry Nicholls his wicket! Loopy ball, a touch shorter, outside off. Nicholls goes for the sweep but does not middle it. The man at deep square leg, Mushfiqur Rahim, makes no mistake. New Zealand slide further. Yes, Latham is still there but the Kiwi skipper is running out of partners at the moment.
Commentary.Howout: c Mushfiqur Rahim b Mahedi Hasan

Commentary.Commentary: Shorter ball, outside off. Pushed to covers.
FOUR! Henry Nicholls gets the boundary! Loopy ball, on leg. Nicholls gets low and sweeps it wide of deep square leg for a boundary.
Mahedi Hasan (3-0-6-1) is back on.
Tell you what, had Latham not hit that, he could have been a candidate for LBW. Full ball, on middle. Latham plays the reverse sweep but straight to the man at short third man.
Just a single as the sweep by Nicholls goes towards deep mid-wicket.
Shorter ball, outside off. Latham works it to short third man for one.
Darted on the pads. Whipped away bu Henry Nicholls for one.

OUT! TAKEN! The spinner gets Colin de Grandhomme! Ahmed fires a full one, on the pads. Colin de Grandhomme brings out the whip and nails it. But he hits it straight to the man at deep square leg. Mushfiqur Rahim takes the catch, the ball pops out but Rahim holds on. Henry Nicholls will bat now.
Commentary.Howout: c Mushfiqur Rahim b Nasum Ahmed

Commentary.Commentary: Flatter ball, on off. Pushed to point.
Nasum Ahmed (2-0-14-0) is back on. Spinner vs Colin de Grandhomme should be a good battle.

SIX! Latham nails this! That is a much-needed maximum for New Zealand. Slower ball again, on a length and on leg. Latham gets low and sweeps it all the way over the square leg fence. Wonderful shot. 57 needed in the last 6 overs.
Slower ball, on a length, outside off. Pushed to covers.
Two now! Length ball, on the pads. Latham whips it between deep mid-wicket and deep square leg for a couple of runs.
Length ball, outside off. Colin de Grandhomme drills it to long on for a single.
Length ball, on off. Pushed to long on for one.
Full and on the pads. Flicked away. The man from short fine leg dives to his right and keeps it to one.
Length ball, outside off. Latham nails the drive but straight towards cover. The fielder dives and stops the ball.
Shorter ball, down the leg side. Colin de Grandhomme pulls it to fine leg for one.
Back of a length, on leg. Worked to mid-wicket.
Full ball, on off. Pushed to mid off for a quick single.

NOT OUT! Latham survives! The ball is going past the stumps! Length ball, on off. Latham shuffles across and looks to work it to the leg side. He misses and gets hit on the pads. The umpire thinks for a while and then raises the finger. Latham reviews it. This looks dead straight but Ball Tracker has a surprise for all of us! The ball is going past the leg stump!
Review time! Tom Latham has reviewed this LBW decision. No bat on that one but the ball is going past the stumps!
Full ball, on the pads. Worked to long on for one.
Mustafizur Rahman is back on. He went for 9 runs in his first over.
Length ball, on the pads. Pushed to wide long on for a single.
Nicely done. Length ball, outside off. Latham works it towards short third man and sets off for a quick single.
FOUR! Thrashed by Latham! Shorter ball, outside off. Latham pulls it away. The man at mid-wicket dives but cannot get there. The ball runs to the fence.
Length ball, on the pads. Whipped to deep square leg for one.
Back of a length, outside off. Colin de Grandhomme heaves it towards deep square leg for a couple of runs.

A direct hit and Colin de Grandhomme would have been gone! Length ball, on off. Pushed to covers. Colin de Grandhomme wants the run but Latham sends him back as the ball goes straight to the fielder. The fielder misses his shy at the bowler's end. There is an overthrow and they finally get a single.
Colin de Grandhomme walks out to bat now. 81 needed in the last 9 overs.

OUT! TAKEN! Shakib Al Hasan does it again and breaks the crucial stand! Tossed up, outside off. Will Young looks to drive it over covers but gets the outside edge. Mohammad Saifuddin runs in from short third man and dives to get a very good catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Mohammad Saifuddin b Shakib Al Hasan

Commentary.Commentary: Nicely bowled! Shakib Al Hasan bowls it slower and a touch shorter. Young looks to slog sweep it but misses.
Flatter ball, on off. Punched away for one.
Loopy ball, on off. Latham reverse-sweeps it past short third man for a couple of runs.
Fuller ball, angling away from the off pole. Latham misses the sweep.
Young comes down the track and pushes it to long off for one.
A nice-looking drive towards long on by Young for a single.
Back of a length, outside off. Latham works it late towards short third man for one.
Excellent running. Length ball, on the pads. Latham works it towards long on. But he plays it with soft hands. The fielder charges in but the batters take a couple.
Shorter ball, outside off. Young punches it past covers for a single.
Fuller ball, on the pads. Latham works it towards square leg for one. These two are rotating the strike quite well now.
On a length, around off. Young whips it to the leg side for a single.
Mohammad Saifuddin is in the attack now.
Darted on the pads. Worked to mid-wicket.
Nicely played. Loopy ball, on off. Latham sweeps it to deep mid-wicket for a couple of runs. 50 up for the Kiwis.
Shorter ball, outside off. Young cuts it past point for one.
Shorter ball, on off. Latham turns it past mid-wicket for one.
Loopy ball, on the pads. Young works it to the leg side for one.
Tossed up, on off. Latham goes for the reverse sweep but gets the top edge. The ball goes over the keeper for a single.
Shakib Al Hasan (1-0-8-1) is back on.
FOUR! You bowl short to Young, you get punished! Shorter ball, down the leg side. Young rocks back and pulls it between deep square leg and deep mid-wicket for a boundary.
Loopy ball, on the pads. Young works it to mid-wicket.
Flatter ball, on off. Blocked out.
Shorter ball, outside off. Latham punches it towards deep mid-wicket for one.
Darted on the pads. Worked to square leg for one.
Short and way outside off. Latham slaps it to long on for one.
Mahmudullah to bowl now.
Shorter ball, outside off. Latham slaps it to deep point for one.
Short of a length, on leg. Young taps it to the right of the bowler and they take a quick single.
On a length, around off. Latham pushes it past mid-wicket for one.
Short ball, on the leg stump. Young pulls it down to the fine leg fence.
Length ball, on the pads. Latham works it past square leg for a single.
FOUR! Very nicely played by the Kiwi skipper! Shorter ball, outside off. Latham ramps it to the third man fence.
Mustafizur Rahman to bowl now.
Just a single from the last over of the Powerplay. Tossed up, outside off. Young misses the sweep and gets hit on the pads.
Loopy ball, on off. Blocked out.
Fuller ball, on off. Pushed to the right of the bowler. Hasan gets across and gathers the ball.
Shorter ball, lands outside off and stays a bit low. Young gets his bat down in time to work it towards point.
Fuller ball, on off. Pushed past covers for one.
Shorter ball, on leg. Latham works it towards mid-wicket.
Loopy ball, on the pads. Blocked out.
FOUR! Another boundary for Young! He comes down the track and takes the ball on the full. He then whips it hard to the mid-wicket fence.
FOUR! That should release some of the pressure that was building up on the Kiwis! Shorter ball, on off. Young rocks back and pulls it to the wide long on fence.
Make that three dots in a row! Shorter ball, around off. Pushed to the off side.
Shorter ball, outside off. Young cuts it straight towards point.
Flatter ball, outside off. Young punches it to covers.
Flatter ball, on off. Pushed back to the bowler.
Darted on the pads. Young works it to the leg side for one.
Shorter ball, outside off. Pushed towards covers.
Loopy ball, on off. Young solidly blocks it.
Tossed up, on off. Blocked out.

OUT! STUMPED! Bangladesh are well and truly on top now! Tom Blundell comes down the track so Hasan bowls it a touch shorter. Tom Blundell looks to whip it away but misses. He is way down the track so Nurul Hasan has plenty of time to whip the bails off. He actually waits for the batter to look back at him and then whips it off. Will Young walks out to bat now.
Commentary.Howout: st Nurul Hasan b Mahedi Hasan

Commentary.Commentary: Loopy ball, on the pads. Worked to square leg.
Darted on the pads. Worked to the leg side for one.
Flatter ball, on leg. Pushed to long on for one.
Tom Latham walks out to bat.

OUT! BOWLED! Shakib Al Hasan gets his revenge! Shorter ball, on off. Ravindra goes back for the pull but misses. The ball deflects off his thigh and goes onto hit the stumps! 126 needed in 105 balls now.
SIX! Top shot! Loopy ball, on off. Rachin Ravindra dances down the track and hits it straight back over the bowler for a maximum.
Nicely tossed up, on off. Rachin Ravindra comes forward and blocks it.
Shakib Al Hasan to bowl now.
FOUR! Smacked by Tom Blundell! He gets a short ball, on leg. He goes back and hammers it to the mid-wicket fence.
Darted around off. Pushed to the off side.
Flatter ball, angling into the middle stump. Tom Blundell pushes it to covers.
Flatter ball, on the pads. Worked to deep square leg for one.
Shorter ball, outside off. Rachin Ravindra works it to covers.
Loopy ball, on off. Pushed to mid off.
Shorter ball, down the leg side. Ravindra misses the pull. Wide called.
Nasum Ahmed to bowl now.
Shorter ball, on the pads. Worked to square leg.

Just past the stumps! Loopy ball, on off. Ravindra looks to block but gets the inside edge past the stumps. The ball goes towards fine leg. The fielder chases it and stops it from going to the ropes. Three taken.
Loop ball, on off. Rachin Ravindra blocks it solidly.
Tossed up, on leg. Blocked out.
New Zealand are underway! Shorter ball, on the pads. Tom Blundell works it past square leg for one.
Flatter ball, around off. Tom Blundell rocks back and pushes it to covers.
